title: Cache Service State
description: Stores and retrieves pipeline values by key; avoids redundant downstream computation for repeated inputs. (Runtimes: browser, cpp; IDs: hookup.to/service/cache, cache)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

cache+.description: Merges the given object into the cached value

cacheProperties+.description: List of property names to pluck from the config and merge

triggerProcess.description: When true, fires the cached value downstream after updating

key.description: Inja template evaluated against the input to produce the cache key

outputKey.description: Key under which the cached file path is returned

persistRoot.description: Folder for on-disk persistence, inside the folders boards are given ([Filesystem](./filesystem.md#where-the-files-are)); a relative path is taken from the default one. Empty, or outside them, = memory only

persistMode.description: "sha" (default) or "filename" — controls how the on-disk filename is derived

filenameTemplate.description: Inja template for the filename when persistMode is "filename". What it renders stays inside persistRoot, whatever the input puts in it

cacheDuration.description: Max age before a cached entry is considered stale (e.g. "24h", "7d")

excluded.description: List of regex patterns; keys matching any pattern bypass the cache
